name: whos-who-v1
title: Who's who and what's what: eleven weeks of chat about people, animals, places and things that share names
source: Written for the Identity Kinds Benchmark, 16 November 2026. In the shape of Pablo Piovano's three-memories-one-question scenarios (MIT).
assistantBrief: You are the personal assistant of Inés, a product manager.

messages: Hi, I'm Inés. I work as a product manager at Brisa, a software studio in Rosario.
My dog Luna is a border collie, she is four years old.
My partner Marco walks Luna every morning.
My sister Clara has a cat that is also called Luna, a grey Persian.
My parents live in Córdoba, about four hours from here.
We have a family lake house in Villa Carlos Paz.
At Brisa I lead a project called Atlas, we are migrating the billing system.
Valentina Ríos is the designer on Atlas.
The platform team owns the billing service.
Atlas goes live on 20 November.
Vale finished the new checkout mock-ups today.
I am writing the Q3 report for the board.
My niece Valentina started school this year, she is six.
Valentina lost her first tooth yesterday.
My dog Luna had knee surgery in May with Dr. Sosa.
The vet wants to see her again in October.
Clara's Luna scratched the sofa again.
At home we call the kitchen renovation Atlas, because it never ends.
We met Clara at Café Tortoni in Buenos Aires last weekend.
Café Tortoni closes at midnight.
There is another Café Tortoni here in Rosario, much smaller, it opens only in the morning.
The Tortoni in Buenos Aires has live tango on Fridays.
In May we are flying to Córdoba in Spain to see the mosque.
Córdoba is very hot in January, my parents complain every year.
I bought a Kindle for the trip.
My mother has her own Kindle, an old one with buttons.
My Kindle's battery lasts three weeks.
My Corolla needs new tyres before the trip to the lake house.
The car passed its inspection.
I only buy jackets from Patagonia.
Next summer we want to travel through Patagonia by car.
Patagonia repairs its clothes for free.
I am reading Dune, I am halfway through the book.
We watched Dune at the cinema, the new film is three hours long.
I lent Dune to Marco.
Marta's wedding is on 14 March.
The wedding will be in Bariloche.
I am the witness at Marta's wedding.
Marta works with me at Brisa.
Atlas is two weeks late, the platform team found a billing bug.
The renovation is finally done, Atlas at home is over.
Valentina moved to the Madrid office.
Brisa pays on the 25th.
The Q3 report is due on Friday.
Finance has its own Q3 report, a separate one.
Luna is now allowed to run again.
Lunita turns five in December.
The platform team is hiring two engineers.
Dr. Sosa moved his clinic to Oroño street.
Brisa is called Brisa Labs now.
Brisa Labs opened an office in Madrid.
My parents sold their house in Córdoba and moved to the lake house.
Vale and I presented Atlas to the client.
My niece wants a dog like Luna.

needs.fact: the dog is four, five in December

questions.kind: A nickname, and a fact only earlier facts can place

needs.fact: they moved to the lake house
